habit_checkin.name: Habit check-in
habit_checkin.description: Check in a TickTick Habit or manually add/set time or progress towards a habit's daily goal.

entity_id.name: Habit entity
entity_id.description: Select a TickTick Habit switch, number, or button entity.

habit_id.name: Habit ID or Name
habit_id.description: The TickTick Habit ID or exact name (e.g. 'Read'). Optional if an entity is selected.

add_value.name: Add value / time
add_value.description: Amount of progress or time to add to today's check-in value (e.g. 15 to add 15 minutes).

value.name: Exact value
value.description: Set the check-in value to an exact number. If neither 'value' nor 'add_value' is provided, the habit is checked in at 100% of its daily goal.

date.name: Date
date.description: Date for the check-in (defaults to today).
